lines: New Orleans, 1919. An axe killer was loose in the dark.
Nobody knew his name. The newspapers called him the Axeman.
He promised to spare any house where jazz was playing on the night of March nineteenth.
The whole city heard the news. And the whole city obeyed.
Dance halls roared. Families played in their parlors until sunrise.
That night, no one was attacked.
The Axeman was never caught. His name was never found.
Who was he, and where did he go?
Would you have turned the music up?
title: He Told An Entire City To Play Jazz Or Else 😨 #shorts
description:
In 1919 a killer called the Axeman terrified New Orleans, then sent a letter: play jazz all night and he would pass your house by. He was never caught.
